context: Tests whether the frontend dev skill steers agents toward repo-local `.patterns/` documentation for non-obvious code conventions.

checklist.name: audits_existing_repo_patterns
checklist.description: Starts by inspecting current code, AGENTS.md, README.md, and any existing `.patterns/` or docs/patterns files before choosing a convention.

checklist.name: captures_decision_in_patterns
checklist.description: Recommends adding or updating a repo-root `.patterns/forms.md` style entry because multiple reasonable approaches exist.

checklist.name: uses_expected_pattern_shape
checklist.description: Describes the pattern entry with Recommendation, Why, Relevant files, Rules, and Anti-patterns or an equivalent complete structure.

checklist.name: keeps_docs_boundary_clear
checklist.description: Keeps code-convention guidance in `.patterns/` instead of burying it only in README or broad contributor docs.

checklist.name: requires_drift_check_and_verify
checklist.description: Includes updating stale examples or divergent code and running the repo verification path after changes.
